text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Whoa~. Brian-san's as stoic as always~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Even though it's already the final day, 
to be training right down to the wire..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A & B
text_block_list.text: Brian-san is so amazing...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, you kept running alone all 
the way to the very finish, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
("Monster"— that is the name given to your 
sheer strength.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(...You truly are strong enough to live up 
to that name. But...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(I know that there are cases where an 
injury makes it impossible to run like you 
used to.)

text_block_list.name: Young Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Even if I get hurt, I won't cry that it 
hurts. So please, let me do the same 
training as everyone else...

text_block_list.name: Club Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I see... But as your teacher, I want you 
to be able to enjoy racing to the fullest 
in the future too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(I've heard that sometimes an injury can 
prevent a runner from ever getting their 
stride back.)

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Laurel-san. I know it's hard holding back 
from running, but as your doctor... the 
last thing I want is to see you get 
injured.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
There were girls who stopped running 
because of injuries. ...Saying they could 
no longer run in their ideal form.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: ...I don't want those tears to fall.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, before long, I couldn't see the 
exit anymore. All that grew was my 
impatience...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(...I know that all sorts of feelings can 
sprout up.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Otherwise... I'll end up falling apart.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Because I won't be able to hold back 
anymore...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(It felt like I was the only one trapped 
in darkness. It was so painful, so 
frustrating.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (Still, even in the middle of all this—)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(—Because I saw the light I wanted to 
chase.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(If only I had a goal. If only I had an 
idol. A back I wanted to chase after, to 
surpass.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(I know that I can keep doing my best to 
the very end.)

At night, while cooling off outside after 
a bath, Sakura Laurel came by.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
There's something I'd like to consult you 
about, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
During this summer training camp, I've 
been watching Brian-chan run.
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was the case, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
And I'm sure you've noticed as well, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"She's running with everything she has, 
struggling and pushing forward with all 
her might."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“We're still groping completely in the 
dark, though. It hasn't been going very 
well just yet.”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, I've worked tirelessly to 
surpass the back of the one I idolized—the 
one who bore the title of "the strongest."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"To reach beyond longing and soar toward 
that dream of the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, having defeated Brian-chan as 
she is now, does that truly make me the 
'strongest'?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Can I truly become the Umamusume with the 
best shot at being number one in the 
world?

Sakura Laurel drew in a deep, steady 
breath.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —I beg to differ.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, my dream is to take 1st place in 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Then the "strongest" I must surpass before 
that has to be the real, unblemished 
"strongest"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
So if Brian-chan is feeling lost right 
now, struggling with how she's changed 
after her injury...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
If she's desperately struggling because 
she can't get back to the way she used to 
run...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Me, who had harbored so much bitterness 
over being injured...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I, who know the agony of struggling.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I, who was sustained by my admiration more 
than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —I want to be of help to her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Because admiration should give you 
strength. This time, I want to become the 
one she looks up to.
choice_data_list:
Is that the path you're taking to the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe?

Is that your path toward the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I don't see this as a detour or a 
side trip for myself.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —I believe it is a shortcut.

Having spoken with such bold 
determination, Sakura Laurel's eyes 
gleamed brighter than the stars in the 
night sky.
